issues.finding: 標籤容易被讀成encoder的輸入；圖沒有回答本節標題所問梯度如何返回入口。程式中labels只進loss，反向沿scores→mean→features→projection。
issues.impact: 影響圖片入口、監督targets及反向鏈式微分的資料流理解。
issues.suggested_fix: 保留兩張實際scene圖和方塊0/圓形1；圖片箭頭連至入口，類別標籤另連到交叉熵框。從loss另畫方向相反、標明梯度的箭頭回到分類頭/平均/入口，保留未optimizer.step()。可用兩條明示forward/backward的路徑，避免把圖僅畫成步驟列表。
issues.resolution: New blue paths start at the red-square/right-blue-circle images and end at the composite entrance→mean→classifier→scores box. Gold label paths bypass it and enter cross-entropy at both sides. A blue scores path points down to loss; a separately labeled red gradient path points up from loss to the composite computation box. Both sizes show the routes and no-step note. All 512 original source pixels remain exact.
issues.resolution_support_boundary: The diagram groups the scoring stages in one box; the reverse arrow returns to that composite differentiable computation, whose entrance gradient is checked by unchanged fence execution. It does not claim trained recognition, label correctness, image-pixel gradients, or parameter updates.

issues.original: 原實驗的資料切分、更新設定與逐題結果見既有實報…這是上述有限任務的歷史紀錄。
